# gnomon

> gnomon is a terminal coding agent whose behaviour is fixed by a content-hashed `.gnomon/` directory in the repository, not by the machine. Roles are separated by the tools they are offered, every change is gated behind an approval diff by default, every step lands in one of three outcome buckets (result, refusal, apparatus_failure), and a hash-chained audit trail records what happened. It runs local models (Ollama, llama.cpp, any OpenAI-compatible server) and cloud models, per role, and `gnomon check` applies the same rules to work done by other harnesses such as Claude Code and opencode. Node 22+; MIT; pre-1.0.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/scripts/install.sh | sh` (Linux/macOS) or `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/scripts/install.ps1 | iex` (Windows). Then, in the project: `gnomon setup` (pick a model; writes `.gnomon/` only on the user's yes), optionally `gnomon dashboard` (the same steps in a browser), then `gnomon launch`. The installer installs the latest release, v0.5.0, with its native binaries. From v0.5.0 the package is also on npm as `gnomon-harness` (`npm i -g gnomon-harness`; the command is `gnomon`).

Defaults are the recommendation: on Claude Haiku the release defaults did at least as well as a tuned long-task recipe at about half the cost. Hybrid local + cloud is opt-in, not a default and not a quality upgrade (local-first with cloud rescue, PR #180, unreleased, measured as a cost mode); the completion/done checks are opt-in and improve answer honesty, not task outcomes.

Agents configuring gnomon for a user: follow section 11 of the guide. Never put API keys in `.gnomon/` (use `gnomon key set <endpoint>`), never guess a model id (use `gnomon endpoint list`), and verify with `echo /quit | gnomon prompt`, which makes no model call.

## Docs

- [The gnomon guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/GUIDE.md): what it is, architecture, install, quick start, model recipes, commands, use cases, troubleshooting, FAQ, and a step-by-step procedure for agents
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/README.md): the full reference, including The Six Rules and Known Limits
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/GETTING_STARTED.md): per-platform install steps, including Windows and from source
- [Contracts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/CONTRACTS.md): exit codes, enumerations, record shapes, the TOML subset gnomon parses, the `gnomon check` verdict schema

## Optional

- [Positioning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/POSITIONING.md): where gnomon sits against other harnesses, and what has been measured
- [Evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/EVIDENCE.md): every claim gnomon makes about itself, with the measurement and its date
- [gnomon Bench Standards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/benchmarks/README.md): draft v0.1 open benchmark standards for harness-determined measures (overhead, hybrid local/cloud cost-quality, governance conformance, reporting)
- [Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/DESIGN.md): the decisions forced by "behaviour is a property of the repository"
- [Governance check design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/GOVERNANCE-CHECK-DESIGN.md): how `gnomon check` judges other harnesses' work
- [Sandbox design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/SANDBOX-DESIGN.md): what `[sandbox] exec = "docker"` does and does not contain
- [Exec threat model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/docs/THREAT-MODEL-EXEC.md): the invariant `exec = "docker"` rests on, which layer enforces each part, accepted limits
- [Agents working on this repository](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eljaplacido/gnomonharness/master/AGENTS.md): build, test and conventions for contributors
